body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.80 (naive base rate 0.75) that: Laurus Labs Q3 FY27 consolidated operating margin is ≥30.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (29-Oct-2026): EBITDA margin ~34%, highest ever; +₹200 cr revenue QoQ (operating leverage), CDMO ~40% of mix. Founder Dr Chava: 'comfortable in maintaining over 60% gross margin and over 30% EBITDA… we still stick to our guidance.' Screener OPM: Dec-25 27%, Mar-26 28%, Jun-26 32%, Sep-26 34%; sales growth +29%/+33% YoY in Q1/Q2. Capex guide ₹3,000 cr over FY27–28; H1 run-rate below that. Reasoning: Guide is a floor with 4 pts of headroom and a rising trend; CDMO lumpiness is the main risk. Slightly above persistence base. Resolution: YES if Q3 FY27 (Dec-2026 quarter) consolidated Operating Profit ÷ Sales on screener.in is ≥30.0% (company-reported EBITDA margin used if screener unavailable). Source: screener.in Laurus Labs consolidated quarterly results; Laurus Q3 FY27 press release. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: A margin 4 pts above a threshold stays above it next quarter ~75% of the time for mid-cap pharma/CDMO.
